represented_appearance: Bridge-facing appearance documented 2017–2025: cream panels, dark plinth, green fascia and lettering, glazed entry/cylindrical kiosk. Roof 3D date not available.

coverage.observations: Two broad wings, shallow rising convex roof with green rim, central higher translucent barrel entrance canopy, panel joints, small paired square vents, green central entry and service kiosk, one outer green utility door.
Cream rectangular cladding grid, dark plinth, low eaves, single green door towards bridge, simple gutter/fascia.
Cladding grid and single narrow dark/green door visible on one oblique; high sunlight and depth foreshortening limit layout.

Opposing actual 3D shows smooth light cylindrical wall, round flat blue-grey roof and connection to raised canopy. Mapillary rear path imagery faces away; no close rear elevation found. Do not assert rear windows or lettering.
Wing roofs slope gently outward from central spine, flat-round drum roof, translucent curved/ribbed canopy; roof weathering/blue patch varies by date.
Rectangular paved approach to entry joins the loop path and Venetian bridge axial approach. Loop lawn and bridge approach remain in separate public-realm owner.
